about.disclaimer: Melodesk is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Google LLC or YouTube. YouTube and YouTube Music are trademarks of Google LLC.
about.text: Melodesk is an open-source desktop client that drives the official YouTube Music web player. MIT licensed.
backup.body: Keep your settings, themes, plugin choices and lyric corrections in a file, for a new computer or a fresh start.
backup.confirm.body: {settings} settings from {date}. They replace your current settings of the same name; the rest stays.
backup.confirm.history: Replace my listening history with the {count} plays in the file
backup.confirm.title: Restore this backup?
backup.noSecrets: Passwords, keys and tokens are never put in the file: type them in again after restoring. Covers and other caches are not included; they fill up again.
backup.notBackup: That is not a Melodesk backup.
backup.restored: Restored. Starting again with your settings…
backup.title: Back up and restore
backup.tooBig: That file is too large to be a backup.
control.body: Stream Deck, Home Assistant, Raycast or a script on this computer can ask what is playing and send play, pause, next, previous and volume.
control.enable: Allow programs on this computer to control Melodesk
control.safe: It listens on this computer only, answers only requests with the token, and refuses web pages. Treat the token like a password.
control.title: Control from other programs
crash.body: This page ran into a problem. The rest of Melodesk is fine, and your music keeps playing.
crash.title: Something went wrong
feature.audio-engine.description: Equalizer and volume leveling. Not available on macOS and Linux.
feature.audio-engine.name: Audio engine
feature.backup.description: Save your settings and listening history to a file, and restore them.
feature.backup.name: Backup and restore
feature.browse.description: Explore, charts, moods and genres, and new releases.
feature.browse.name: Explore, charts and moods
feature.command-palette.description: Press Cmd/Ctrl+K to search and run commands.
feature.command-palette.name: Command palette
feature.context-menu.description: Context menus for text, links, the player and the page.
feature.context-menu.name: Right-click menus
feature.control-api.description: Let other programs on this computer ask what is playing and control it, with a secret token.
feature.control-api.name: Control API
feature.detail.description: Pages for artists, albums and playlists.
feature.detail.name: Artist, album and playlist pages
feature.global-shortcuts.description: Hotkeys that work from any app to play, pause, skip and show the window.
feature.global-shortcuts.name: Global shortcuts
feature.first-run.description: A few pointers for new users on the Home page until you dismiss them.
feature.first-run.name: Getting-started tips
feature.home.name: Home
feature.integrations.description: Last.fm, ListenBrainz, Discord presence and lyrics providers (opt-in plugins).
feature.integrations.name: Integrations
feature.karaoke.description: Full-screen sing-along lyrics with word-by-word highlighting.
feature.karaoke.name: Karaoke mode
feature.keyboard.description: Keys that work anywhere in the app, like Space for play and pause, and a cheat sheet on ?.
feature.keyboard.name: Keyboard shortcuts
feature.library.description: Your playlists, songs, albums, artists, podcasts and history.
feature.library.name: Library
feature.local-music.description: Play the music files on this computer, in the same player as YouTube Music.
feature.local-music.name: Local music
feature.lyrics.description: Timed lyrics with romanization, translation and sync controls.
feature.lyrics.name: Lyrics
feature.mini-player.name: Mini player
feature.now-playing.name: Now Playing
feature.offline-artwork.description: Keeps cover art for when you are offline.
feature.offline-artwork.name: Offline cover art
feature.playlist-import.description: Bring a playlist from a CSV, M3U, JSON or text file into your YouTube Music account.
feature.playlist-import.name: Import playlists
feature.playlist-tools.description: Sort, merge, remove duplicates from and export playlists.
feature.playlist-tools.name: Playlist tools
feature.podcasts.description: Follow podcasts by their feed and play episodes, with your place remembered.
feature.podcasts.name: Podcasts
feature.queue-tools.description: Remove duplicates, save the queue as a playlist, sleep timer and playback speed.
feature.queue-tools.name: Queue tools
feature.queue.description: The live queue panel with drag-and-drop reordering.
feature.queue.name: Queue
feature.radio.description: Listen to internet radio stations you add or find in a directory.
feature.radio.name: Internet radio
feature.resume.description: A card on Home to continue the song you were in the middle of.
feature.resume.name: Continue listening
feature.search.description: Search with live suggestions and filters.
feature.search.name: Search
feature.server.description: Browse and play the music on a Subsonic-compatible server of your own, such as Navidrome.
feature.server.name: Music server
feature.settings.description: Preferences, and the list of features.
feature.settings.name: Settings
feature.sound.description: An equalizer, even volume between songs and crossfade for the music on this computer.
feature.sound.name: Sound
feature.visualizer.description: Visuals that move with the music: a Visualizer tab in Now Playing, and glows and bars around the app.
feature.visualizer.name: Music visuals
feature.stats.description: Your listening history, top songs and top artists.
feature.stats.name: Listening stats
features.dependents: Turning this off also turns off {names}.
health.broken: Melodesk can’t control YouTube Music right now. An app update is probably needed.
health.degraded: Some controls may not work. An app update is probably needed.
health.slow: The player is taking a while to start. Reloading it usually helps.
import.body: Each song in the file is looked up in YouTube Music, and the ones found go into a new playlist in your account.
import.formats: Works with CSV (including Spotify exports), M3U/M3U8, JSON and plain “Artist - Title” lists.
import.name: Playlist name
import.noMatch: No match, this one is left out
import.notReady: Waiting for YouTube Music to be ready.
import.nothing: No songs were found in that file.
import.title: Import a playlist
import.tooBig: That file is too large to be a playlist.
karaoke.shortcuts: Space play/pause · ← → seek · [ ] adjust timing · Esc close
karaoke.untimed: These lyrics aren’t timed, so they can’t follow the music. Scroll to read along.
keys.note: These work when you are not typing in a field and nothing like a slider or button has focus. Global shortcuts that work from other apps are in Settings.
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
local.edit.noLyrics: Saved. This file type has no place for lyrics; save them in a .lrc file next to it instead.
local.edit.title: Edit song info
local.edit.warning: This changes the tags stored inside the file itself. The sound is not touched.
local.empty.body: Add a folder with music files and Melodesk lists them here. The files stay where they are; only what is written in them (title, artist, length) is remembered.
local.empty.title: No music here yet
local.gone.body: These songs are no longer in your folders. Scan again, or go back to the list.
local.gone.title: Nothing here any more
local.scanning: Reading your music… {found} files so far
local.settings.body: Songs in these folders (and the folders inside them) are listed under Local music. They are read on this computer only.
local.settings.formats: This computer can’t play these file types: {formats}
local.settings.title: Local music folders
local.smart.empty.body: A smart playlist follows rules, like “never played” or “added this month”, and is always up to date.
local.smart.empty.title: No smart playlists yet
local.smart.hint: Leave a rule empty to ignore it. The list is worked out every time you open it.
local.smart.name: Name
local.smart.sort.title: Title
local.smart.text: Title, artist, album or genre contains
local.title: Local music
local.unsupported: “{title}” is in a format this computer can’t play.
lyrics.caveat.abjad: Arabic and Hebrew are written without vowels, so romanization is approximate.
lyrics.caveat.kanji: Chinese characters and Japanese kanji are read as Mandarin offline, so romanization may be wrong.
lyrics.consent.body: The lyric text is sent to MyMemory (api.mymemory.translated.net) to be translated. Nothing else is sent, and each song is requested once, then kept on this computer. For full privacy, use a LibreTranslate server running on this computer instead (see translation settings).
lyrics.consent.title: Translate lyrics?
lyrics.err.libreAddress: Enter your LibreTranslate address, e.g. http://localhost:5000
lyrics.err.libreLocalOnly: Only a LibreTranslate server on this computer (localhost) is allowed.
lyrics.err.network: Could not reach the translation service ({detail})
lyrics.err.quota: Today’s free translation quota is used up. Try again tomorrow or use a local LibreTranslate.
lyrics.err.sameLanguage: The song language and the target language are the same.
lyrics.line.explainFailed: Couldn’t get an explanation. Is Ollama running on this computer?
lyrics.line.explainOff: To explain lines, turn on “Local AI song finder” in Settings → Plugins.
lyrics.finder.artistHint: Leave empty if you are not sure
lyrics.finder.hint: Covers and remixes are uploaded under their own names. Type the song they are of and the lyrics are looked up for that.
lyrics.finder.title: Song title
lyrics.finder.wrong: Wrong or missing lyrics? Look up another song
lyrics.noTimed: No timed lyrics found for this song, so lines can’t follow the music.
lyrics.none: No lyrics available for this song.
lyrics.opt.label: Lyrics options
lyrics.playToSee: Play something to see its lyrics.
lyrics.step.ai: Asking the local AI which song this is
lyrics.serviceHint.libre: Nothing leaves this computer. Only localhost addresses are allowed.
lyrics.serviceHint.mymemory: Sends lyric text to api.mymemory.translated.net. Free daily limit applies.
lyrics.songLanguageHint: Romanized lyrics (like Hindi written in English letters) can’t be detected; pick the language here.
lyrics.timedBanner: These lyrics aren’t timed. LRCLIB can provide lyrics that follow the music; it receives the song title, artist and length.
lyrics.timingHint: If lines appear too soon, press Later; if they lag, press Earlier. Remembered for this song.
nav.signInForPlaylists: Sign in to see your playlists
podcasts.add.label: Search for a podcast, or paste its feed address
podcasts.empty.body: Search above, or paste the address of a podcast’s feed.
podcasts.empty.title: No podcasts yet
podcasts.gone: You no longer follow this podcast.
podcasts.intro: Follow a podcast by its feed address, or search the iTunes directory. Episodes are fetched when you play them, and Melodesk remembers where you stopped.
podcasts.title: Podcasts
radio.empty.body: Search above, or paste a station’s stream address (.mp3, .aac, .pls or .m3u).
radio.empty.title: No stations yet
radio.intro: Add a station by its stream address, or find one in the radio-browser.info directory.
radio.name: Name
radio.title: Internet radio
server.intro: Connect a Subsonic-compatible server of your own (Navidrome, Airsonic, Gonic…) to browse and play its music here.
server.noPlaylistsBody: Playlists you make on your server show up here.
server.passwordNote: The password is kept on this computer only and is sent to your server as a one-time token, never as the password itself.
server.title: Music server
sound.crossfade.hint: Local songs fade into each other. Off plays them back to back with no gap.
sound.eq.hint: Shape the sound of local songs.
sound.normalize.hint: Quiet and loud local songs play at a similar level, using the ReplayGain tags in the files. Songs without tags are left as they are.
sound.title: Sound
sound.youtube.active: These settings also apply to YouTube Music on this computer.
sound.youtube.local: These settings apply to local songs. This computer’s web player does not allow processing YouTube Music’s sound.
visualizer.simulatedNote: Moves with the rhythm of playback. On this system Melodesk cannot hear the sound itself.
offline.banner: You are offline. Covers and pages you have already opened still show; playing music and searching need a connection.
palette.title: Command palette
playlist.deleteBody: “{title}” will be deleted from your YouTube Music library.
playlist.form.title: Title
plugin.discord.description: Shows the current song as your Discord activity, with a link to it on YouTube Music.
plugin.discord.field.applicationId.hint: Create an application at discord.com/developers/applications and paste its Application ID. Its name is what Discord shows after "Listening to".
plugin.discord.field.applicationId.label: Discord application ID
plugin.discord.name: Discord Rich Presence
plugin.lastfm.description: Scrobbles what you listen to (title, artist, album) to your Last.fm account.
plugin.lastfm.field.apiKey.label: API key
plugin.lastfm.field.apiSecret.label: Shared secret
plugin.lastfm.name: Last.fm
plugin.listenbrainz.description: Submits what you listen to (title, artist, album) to your ListenBrainz account.
plugin.listenbrainz.field.token.label: User token
plugin.listenbrainz.name: ListenBrainz
plugin.lrclib.description: Shows lyrics from LRCLIB when YouTube Music has none. Sends the track title, artist and duration to lrclib.net.
plugin.lrclib.name: LRCLIB lyrics
plugins.intro: All plugins are off by default. Each one lists exactly what it can reach; integrations that send data say what they send.
plugins.group.activity.hint: Share what you listen to with other services.
plugins.group.identify.hint: Works out which song a cover or remix really is, so its lyrics can be found.
plugins.group.lyrics.hint: Where lyrics come from when YouTube Music has none, or only untimed ones. Every source you switch on is asked at once and the best answer wins.
plugins.title: Plugins
resume.title: Continue listening
queueTools.label: Queue tools
search.prompt: Type to search songs, albums, artists, playlists and podcasts.
settings.accent.hint: Colors across the app are generated from this accent in Material 3 Expressive's tonal palette, so text stays readable.
settings.artworkCacheHint_one: {count} cover kept, {size} of up to {max}. It still shows when you’re offline.
settings.artworkCacheHint_other: {count} covers kept, {size} of up to {max}. They still show when you’re offline.
settings.closeToTray: Keep playing when the window is closed
settings.closeToTrayHint: Closing the window hides it to the system tray.
settings.closeToTrayHintMac: Closing the window hides it; Melodesk stays in the menu bar and Dock.
settings.contrast.hint: Higher contrast makes text, outlines and controls easier to tell apart.
settings.featuresHint: Turn parts of Melodesk on or off. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.
settings.language.hint: Missing translations fall back to English. See docs/translating.md to add a language.
settings.notifyHint: Only while Melodesk is not the focused window.
settings.pageColors.hint: Artist, album and playlist pages take the colors of their artwork. The rest of the app keeps your accent.
settings.shortcutsHint: Work in every app while Melodesk is in the background, so avoid combinations you type or select text with. Click a field and press the keys; Esc cancels and Backspace clears. Media keys are handled by the system and need no setup.
settings.shortcutsInApp: Keys that work inside Melodesk (Space, arrows…)
settings.signInHint: Sign in happens on Google’s own page inside the player window.
settings.themeCode.hint: Share your look: copy its code and send it to a friend to paste here.
settings.themeCode.invalid: That is not a Melodesk theme code.
settings.themes.hint: Ready-made looks: a theme and an accent that go together. You can still change either below.
settings.title: Settings
shortcut.err.clipboard: That is select all, copy, paste, cut or undo in other apps. Pick a different combination.
shortcut.err.editing: Arrow, Home/End and delete keys move or select text in other apps, so they can’t be global shortcuts. Try a letter or F-key with Cmd/Ctrl and Alt.
shortcut.err.noModifier: Add Cmd/Ctrl or Alt, or it would capture ordinary typing in every app.
stats.change.same: About the same listening as the {period} before.
stats.empty: Nothing recorded in this range yet. Play something and come back.
stats.subtitle: Computed on this computer from what Melodesk played. Never uploaded.
stats.summary.head: My Melodesk ({range}): {time} of music.
stats.title: Your listening
toast.signInRequired: Sign in to YouTube Music to do that
tools.applyOrder: Apply this order to the playlist
tools.removeDupesBody_one: {count} duplicate will be removed from this playlist, keeping the first of each.
tools.removeDupesBody_other: {count} duplicates will be removed from this playlist, keeping the first of each.
tools.reorderLimit: Reordering is limited to {max} tracks at a time
tools.sort.title: Title
update.idle: Updates are signed and downloaded from the project’s GitHub releases. Nothing is sent about you.
tips.context.body: Right-click anywhere for what you can do there: songs, playlists, text, links.
tips.context.title: Right-click everything
tips.features.body: Settings has pages for Features and Plugins: switch parts on and off, add lyrics sources.
tips.features.title: Make it yours
tips.nowPlaying.body: Click the cover for lyrics, the queue and music visuals.
tips.nowPlaying.title: Now Playing
tips.palette.body: Press {mod}K to jump anywhere, search or run a command.
tips.palette.title: Command palette
tips.title: Getting started
welcome.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Google or YouTube. YouTube Music is a trademark of Google LLC.
welcome.intro: Melodesk shows your own YouTube Music: your home feed, mixes, library and history, exactly as on the website. Sign in with Google in the player window; nothing about your account passes through Melodesk.
welcome.linkError: Paste a music.youtube.com or youtube.com link.
welcome.orOpenLink: Or open a YouTube Music link
welcome.title: Welcome to Melodesk
